english.meaning: to come after something in order
english.note: Used in 繼…之後, meaning after.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, it has different translations. Apparently, it’s the book with the most translations after the Bible.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉啊，有唔同嘅譯本喇。聽講係繼聖經之後呢，有最多譯本嘅一本書來。
